Apply For Employment Opportunities
==================================

Please drop off applications at City Hall (105 South 3rd Street)  
or mail them to:  
City of Brewster  
P.O. Box 340  
Brewster, WA 98812  
  
[Employment Application

Opens in new window](https://www.cityofbrewsterwashington.org/Documents/Government/Employment%20Opportunities/Application-for-Employment-2020.pdf?t=202404091135230) (Adobe Reader© is required to open.) ([download latest version of Adobe Reader©

Opens in new window](http://get.adobe.com/reader/))

**Mailing/Physical Address**  
City of Brewster  
P.O. Box 340  
105 South 3rd Street  
Brewster, WA 98812
